capabilities: annotate selected text with an inline {text::note}
show annotations in popups on click or hover
edit or remove annotations from the context menu
configure the trigger mode between click and hover
skip annotation syntax inside code blocks, math, and frontmatter
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach short context to a specific phrase in place; annotations normally require creating a separate note or footnote.
summary: Inline annotation plugin that attaches hidden notes to selected text via {text::note} syntax, revealed as a popup on click or hover.
